# Studio canvas

`studio/` is EventCatalog Studio's canvas, copied as it ships alongside `@eventcatalog/visualiser` 5.2.2
(MIT, see `LICENSE`). `collab/room.ts` and `analytics.ts` stand in for live rooms and usage counts, which a
catalog site leaves out.

The copy has three `!`s in `studio/StudioCanvas.tsx` (lines 583 and 1161) for this repository's
`noUncheckedIndexedAccess`. Add them again when you copy a newer version.
